newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan to issue Nov jet and naphtha buy tenders.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to issue Nov jet and naphtha buy tenders.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) is expected to issue tenders to buy jet and naphtha for delivery in November by Wednesday, a company source said on Tuesday.
The source said the company would issue the tenders either later Tuesday or Wednesday.
CPC bought two jet fuel cargoes for arrival in October, one more than its usual, following an unexpected shutdown of one of its crude units at the Taoyuan refinery.
The 100,000-barrel-per-day crude unit has been shutdown since September 14-15 due to the closure of the refinery's crude offloading pipelines due to oil leaks.
CPC paid US$244.80 and $247.82 per tonne for the two jet fuel cargoes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to Keelung or Shen Ao for October 1-31 arrival.
The company bought one 30,000-tonne of heavy naphtha for October 21-31 delivery at around $200 per tonne on a c-and-f basis to Kaoshiung.
